card.name: "for" after sterile water or drug name
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after "Sterile Water" or a product name, as in "Sterile Water for Injection" or "Injection for oral solution". Also fires on a few odd spots inside URLs and long names.

modes.label: for in dosage form names
modes.description: The word "for" linking a drug or diluent name to its dosage form, such as injection or oral solution.
modes.example: Table 1: Volume of Sterile Water<< for>> Injection for Reconstitution of Injection Vials

modes.label: Inside URLs and names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a web address or a long name, with no clear link to drug text.

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens and the output; mostly odd or non-English pieces.
card.plain: It marks the word "for" in phrases like "Sterile Water for Injection", where the dosage form comes next.
